$comment: Controls optional FSCR pillar-skill selection while creating task context. A unique exact task-code-and-name skill is canonical and may be reused across Oracle offering and functional-area contexts; skill_selection records that relationship explicitly. Oracle task matching is unaffected.
$comment.include_missing_skill: When true, keep a catalog-matched task even when no pillar SKILL.md is found; its skill_path is null. When false, omit that task from task context and the Run Book.
$comment.multiple_skill_policy: SELECT_BY_PRIORITY first prefers exactly one full offering code/name match. When multiple offering candidates remain, it prefers exactly one normalized full functional-area name match within those candidates. Zero offering matches, or zero/multiple functional-area matches, retain the alphabetical-first full-path fallback across all original candidates. SELECT_LEXICOGRAPHIC_PATH always selects the alphabetically first path.
$comment.priority_order: Existing policy identifiers and fallback order are preserved. PROJECT_OFFERING_OR_PILLAR compares full declared offering identity; only offering ties are refined by full functional-area name. No task discovery, sequence, path-substring, or functional-area alias changes.
